name: Garnier Hari Food Aloevera
description:
Garnier Fructis Hydrating Aloe Vera Hair Food (390ml) is a 3-in-1 treatment that provides deep hydration and softness for normal to dry hair. It nourishes without weighing hair down, leaving it light, smooth, and refreshed.

This Garnier Hair Food Aloe Vera can be used as a conditioner, mask, or leave-in treatment, giving you flexible care in one product. As a result, your hair stays hydrated and manageable throughout the day. In addition, its lightweight formula absorbs quickly, helping to smooth hair and add natural shine.

Moreover, the aloe vera extract infuses hair with moisture while keeping it soft and bouncy. This Garnier hydrating mask contains 98% natural-origin ingredients and is free from silicones, parabens, and artificial colorants.Therefore, it provides gentle, everyday nourishment suitable for all hair types.

Also, the clean, vegan formula is dermatologically tested and has a fresh, tropical scent that energizes your routine. With regular use, this Aloe Vera hair treatment restores softness and boosts shine for healthy-looking hair.
